name: MCP Router Bridge
description: Adds /search/smart, /templates/execute, PUT /vault-cas/<path> (atomic compare-and-swap write), GET /smart-env/sources (Smart Connections' vector store, which lives in a dot-directory the REST API will not serve), GET /open/<path>, and GET /ping REST routes to the Local REST API plugin, plus a presence heartbeat for smart-link device detection. Delegates semantic search to Smart Connections, template execution to Templater, guards writes against parallel-session clobbering, and exposes loopback-only no-auth navigation/probe endpoints for clickable http links in chat/terminal contexts. Companion plugin for the multi-vault MCP router. No native binary, no telemetry.
author: tboome33
